scope: square-lattice independent site-percolation threshold and finite-size estimators

policy.notes: Method-specific estimates are retained separately. Parenthetical uncertainties are recorded as quoted by each source and are not automatically interpreted as mutually comparable statistical confidence intervals.

sources.citation: Jesper Lykke Jacobsen, Critical points of Potts and O(N) models from eigenvalue identities in periodic Temperley-Lieb algebras, J. Phys. A 48 (2015) 454003.
sources.estimator_family: eigenvalue identity between topological transfer-matrix sectors
sources.geometry: n x infinity semi-infinite cylinder with periodic transverse direction
sources.data_transcription: Table 2; decimal strings retained as printed

transcription_verification.method: digit-by-digit comparison against Table 2 of arXiv:1507.03027v1, using an extraction written for this check (raw zlib decompression of the PDF content streams and reassembly of the text-showing operators) rather than a third-party PDF library
transcription_verification.result: two rows deviated from the printed strings and were corrected; the other 19 reproduce them exactly
transcription_verification.note: The SHA-256 pin detects drift after a file is committed. It cannot detect an error made at transcription time, which is why these rows were wrong under a green digest for the file's whole history. Only comparison against the primary source finds that class of error.

transcription_corrections.detail: 20th decimal read as 0; the source prints 9
two trailing zeros beyond the 40 decimals printed; numerically identical, corrected to satisfy the printed-string rule in data/README.md

correction_impact.downstream_fits: none affected: every committed fit over this table uses n_min >= 5, so n=1 and n=4 are outside all training windows
correction_impact.frozen_preregistration: predictions/polynomial_widths_22_24.yaml regenerates byte-identically apart from its input_sha256 line; no predicted value, calibration band or model coefficient changes

transcription_verification.method: digit-by-digit comparison against the merged Table 4 of arXiv:2109.12102, extracted the same way as the Jacobsen table; the preprint groups digits in threes, so whitespace is stripped before comparison
